name: Data Structures and Algorithms
shortDescription: The toolkit behind efficient software and coding interviews: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, searching and Big-O analysis.
highlights: Arrays, lists, stacks, queues, hash tables and trees
Graphs, sorting, searching and dynamic programming

name: Object-Oriented Programming
shortDescription: Modelling software with classes and objects. Learn encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, the SOLID principles and composition over inheritance.

name: Design Patterns
shortDescription: Proven solutions to recurring design problems: creational, structural and behavioural patterns with real code in several languages.

name: System Design
shortDescription: Designing systems that scale: load balancing, caching, databases, queues, consistency, availability and the trade-offs behind real-world architectures.
highlights: Load balancers, caches, queues and storage
Designing real systems step by step

name: Microservices
shortDescription: Splitting applications into independently deployable services. Learn service boundaries, communication, data ownership, resilience and observability.

name: Software Testing
shortDescription: The principles of testing software: test types, the testing pyramid, test design techniques, coverage, automation and quality strategy.
highlights: Test levels and the testing pyramid

name: Unit Testing
shortDescription: Writing fast, isolated tests for individual units of code. Learn arrange-act-assert, mocks and test doubles, test-driven development and good test design.

name: Selenium
shortDescription: Browser automation for end-to-end testing in many languages. Learn WebDriver, locators, waits, the page object pattern and cross-browser runs.
highlights: Page objects, grids and CI integration

name: Playwright
shortDescription: Modern end-to-end testing for web apps. Learn auto-waiting locators, fixtures, tracing, mobile emulation, visual comparisons and parallel runs.

name: Cypress
shortDescription: Developer-friendly end-to-end and component testing that runs in the browser with time-travel debugging and automatic waiting.

name: Jest
shortDescription: The widely used JavaScript testing framework. Learn matchers, mocks, snapshot tests, asynchronous tests and coverage reports.

name: Vitest
shortDescription: A fast, Vite-native test runner with a Jest-compatible API, native ESM support and the default unit-test runner for Angular 22 and Vite projects.

name: Clean Code
shortDescription: Writing code that people can read and change: naming, functions, comments, formatting, error handling, code smells and refactoring.

name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
shortDescription: Protecting systems and data. Learn threat models, the OWASP Top 10, authentication, encryption basics, secure coding and incident response.
highlights: The OWASP Top 10 and secure coding
